items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Also, this is before the Newport Jazz Festival in ’54.

Yes. George . . . I remember George, who to me has always looked the same, except I think when I first saw him he was about 20. I met him outside Storyville. At that time I met his mother and father. I knew everybody and his brother Larry. We spent so much time in Boston. We knew a lot of the musicians in different . . . We played a couple of other clubs. There was another club called Jazz at 76, was the name of it. I think we played there maybe before Storyville even [November 1950]. It was Vic Dickenson and…
